name: DetailTile
description:
One fact about an entity: icon, caption label, value and an optional second line. Values
wrap to two lines then end with an ellipsis; the full value is in the title. In tiles
narrower than 13rem the icon box steps aside so the value keeps its room.
signature: ({ label, value, detail, icon, truncate, numeric, className, ...rest }: DetailTileProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: detail
props.description: A second value line in muted text: the OS build under the OS name.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon in the soft tile box. Pass it without a size. Dropped in narrow tiles.

props.name: numeric
props.description: Tabular figures for serials, IPs, versions and sizes.

props.name: truncate
props.description: Keep the value on one line with an ellipsis (identifiers). Default: wrap up to two lines.

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
